questions.q: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
questions.s:
Explanation:

The sentence:

My house / is more / spacious than / my sister.

has a comparison error — specifically a comparison of unlike things.

🧠 Error Type:

Illogical comparison
You're comparing:

  • My house 🔁 My sister

But these two are not comparable.
We should compare:

  • My house 🔁 my sister's house (or my sister’s)

✅ Correct sentence:

My house is more spacious than my sister’s.

✅ "sister's" (possessive form) refers to her house and makes the comparison logical.

⚠️ Why the other segments are correct:

  • "My house" – ✅ Correct subject.

  • "is more" – ✅ Proper comparative structure.

  • "spacious than" – ✅ Correct comparative form.

✅ Final Answer:

my sister (❌ should be “my sister’s”)

one of the goals of my life

The phrase “one of” must be followed by a plural noun. So, “goal” (singular) is incorrect here.

Only option (d) uses correct grammar and meaning.

When it comes to face masks, the (market are flooded with choices).
questions.s:
The singular noun 'market' should be followed by the singular verb 'is', and not plural verb 'are'. This is the violation of subject-verb agreement. Option (b) rectifies this error.
